ordered_diagnoses: Extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type
gold: Richter's transformation presenting as penile ulcer (transformation of chronic lymphocytic leukemia to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma)
shortlist: Extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type

selector.rationale: The biopsy of the glans penis ulcer showed dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes, which were CD20+, CD79a+, and CD5+, and PCR analysis revealed a clonal IgH gene rearrangement, supporting a diagnosis of Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

rejected.label: Extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type
rejected.why: Negative score and lack of specific supporting evidence

rejected.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: Low score and presence of CD20+ and CD79a+ lymphocytes, which are more characteristic of B-cell lymphomas
